pulse.text: **Quiet three hours** — nothing shipped since the noon sweep, and the leaderboard is unchanged with Claude Opus 5 alone at **61** on the Artificial Analysis Index over Fable 5 (60), GPT-5.6 Sol (59) and Kimi K3 (57). The movement is all in GPT-6's near legs, which cooled on three venues at once: Polymarket's September leg slid to **64%** (from 66%), Kalshi's before-Oct-1 to 60% (from 64%) and before-Sep-1 to 24% (from 31.5%), while the December leg holds at 88%. Grok 5 drifted the same direction — Kalshi now prices it **40%** before October, down from 43.5%, against Manifold's far colder 5% before September. Google's next Gemini Pro is the only firm near-term bet left at **89% by Aug 31**, with Polymarket giving it roughly zero chance of landing in July's remaining three days. The louder story is money, not models: Alphabet's raised **$205B** capex and its first negative quarterly free cash flow since 2004 knocked the stock ~7% and made Microsoft's Wednesday earnings the market's next referendum on AI spending, while Amodei spent Monday denying Anthropic ever sought an open-weight ban as Nvidia's rival letter passed 50 signatories.
